visual_identity.core_identity: An amorphous crawling aberration formed from a lumpy fleshlike mass covered in many unrelated eyes and mouths.
visual_identity.silhouette: Low spreading irregular mound with several protruding mouths and eyes distributed across its surface, no stable limbs.
visual_identity.head_features: No single head; multiple mouths of different sizes and several eyes are scattered across the mass.
visual_identity.body_shape: Soft shapeless crawling mound with pseudopod-like lower edges, never resolving into humanoid anatomy.
visual_identity.limb_structure: No fixed limbs or joints; the lower edge spreads and crawls as one amorphous supported mass.
visual_identity.surface: Smooth folds with sparse bumps; mouths and eyes provide identity without dense gore.
must_avoid: too many tiny mouths causing clutter

accuracy_checks: eyes are scattered rather than forming one face

known_failure_modes.symptom: eyes and mouths organize into one normal face
known_failure_modes.correction: redistribute multiple unrelated eyes and mouths across the amorphous mass
use smooth broad folds and only a few large mouths and eyes
restore low crawling mound with no stable tentacle anatomy

scene_identity.size_impression: Medium spreading mass whose width is defined by contact with floor, water, or drain edges.
scene_identity.natural_posture: Fully supported as a low crawling or pooling body against the ground or shallow water.
environment_fit: dungeon drains and wet underground passages
